snippet.title: War Doctor - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Patients arrive daily, but you won’t be able to treat everyone. Who you save, who you turn away, and how you do it ripples far beyond your clinic. 

A consequence-driven narrative game where you play as a volunteer doctor in a war-torn village.
